cause.note: operator's direction in topic 52075 on 2026-09-14 ('three tiers'): deployment-specific operating choices belong in a policy register beneath the purpose, not in constitutional amendments

changes.what: Seeded the register with seventeen operator policies (P-01 to P-17) distilled from the decisions sweep's candidate amendments, each naming the purpose principle it serves and what a deployment may change.
changes.why: The sweep's nineteen candidates were operating policies and engineering defaults rather than general principles; the five general principles went to the purpose (PR #75) and the deployment choices live here.
